description: Plan de prévention du risque inondation (PPRI) de la Vienne à Châtellerault (Vienne) is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by vienne.gouv.fr. Le standard de données COVADIS sur les plans de prévention des risques comporte toutes les spécifications techniques et organisationnelles de stockage au format numérique des données géographiques représentées dans les plans de prévention des risques (PPR). Coverage: FR. Its keywords include données ouvertes. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
